_readme: Confirmed family ties between owners, each with the source that confirms it. No Armenian public register publishes kinship, so nothing here is derived — every entry is a document a reader can open: an asset declaration of a public official (cpcarmenia.am), a court ruling naming the relationship, or a named investigation. a/b may be an owner id (pe:…), a karg.am owner key, or the exact name as it appears in the register.
